pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal patches with high-frequency serrated margins and sharp pixel-level gradients. Geometric shapes are predominantly irregular quadrilaterals and pentagons with jagged, star-like protrusions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of off-white pathways forming a complex topological graph. Junction nodes primarily exhibit tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections. Corridor thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous 1D jagged silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder ridge, characterized by low-amplitude, high-frequency spikes against the sky background.
